messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 PagerDuty triggered: P1 - high error rate for /v1/chat/stream in production (customers: 3 impacted). Alert ID pd-9421. Paging on-call: @sara

sara: I got the page, jumping in. Observed 5xx spike and long tail latencies (~3-6s) for streaming responses. Customers reporting tool actions are failing mid-stream (toolcall errors).

kevin: seeing routing logs show a repeated oscillation between us-east-1:fp16-v2 and eu-west-quant-v1 for the same request IDs. Looks like smart-routing decided to fallback across region/model variant repeatedly.

alan: if quant variant doesn't support tool calling, that could explain tool errors. Is there a compatibility flag mismatch?

maria: pulling compatibility matrix now. One sec.

maria: (logs) matrix ingestion job ran earlier today and marked eu-west-quant-v1 as supporting tool_calling=true. But runtime reports for that variant show tool_calling=false and max_context_tokens=2048 (expected 8192).

beth: timeline from traces: request gets routed to us-east-1:fp16-v2, streaming starts, then routing policy tries eu-west-quant-v1 as a lower-cost fallback; eu-west rejects tool call (unsupported) -> router picks a different variant -> repeat. This creates an oscillation and increases latency + error surface.

alan: can someone paste the router policy that decides fallbacks?

kevin: config snippet from smart-router policy (sanitized):

```
policy {
  primary: ["fp16-v2"]
  fallbacks: ["quant-v1", "fp16-legacy"]
  region_routing: allow_cross_region: true
  compatibility_check: use_matrix_ingestion=true
}
```

maria: matrix entry for eu-west-quant-v1 (as ingested): `{"model":"eu-west-quant-v1","supports_tool_calling":"True","max_context":8192}`. Note the supports_tool_calling value is a string "True" vs boolean true. Our ingestion parser treats any non-empty string as truthy and sets support flag, but runtime metadata expects explicit boolean. The runtime metadata for deployed variant: `{"supports_tool_calling":false,"max_context":2048,"quantized":true}`.

sara: so mismatch between deployed runtime metadata and the ingestion record is causing router to think quant variant supports tool calls. That leads to attempted fallbacks that fail at runtime -> oscillation.

kevin: also seeing a separate bug: quant variant's runtime advertises max_context=2048 but matrix was ingested with 8192. That causes some long-context requests to be routed to quant variant incorrectly; they then fail mid-stream when context limit exceeded.

beth: customer impact: 3 customers on Dedicated capacity hit toolcall failures and increased latency; one reported failed webhook triggers. Impact window ~ 12:10 - now. Estimated requests affected ~1200 in last 15m.

customer-success-bot: Notifying affected customers (ticket ids queued): CS-3912, CS-3913. Asked CSMs to keep customers updated.

sara: Immediate mitigation options: 1) disable cross-region fallbacks globally; 2) turn off quantitative variants from fallback lists; 3) pin routing to model family for streaming routes. I propose we disable cross-region fallback and remove quant variants from fallbacks for streaming/toolcall routes. That will be fast rollback.

alan: +1. Also push a hotfix to matrix ingestion to normalize boolean types and validate context sizes; add unit test.

kevin: I'm applying mitigation 2: removing quant-v1 from fallbacks for streaming routes now. Pushing config change to smart-router staged rollout (step 1/3).

oncall-roster-bot: @sara is currently on call (P1). Scheduled handoff to @beth in 2 hours.

kevin: change applied to 20% of routers, monitoring for 30s.

maria: telemetry: error rate drop beginning at 2080123498. 50% routers show lower 5xx; overall 5xx reduced by ~60% in affected routes so far.

kevin: increasing rollout to 100% now.

sara: Mitigation complete at 2080123525. Cross-region oscillation stopped, toolcall errors fall to baseline. No need for immediate rollback of deployments.

alan: root cause summary draft: compatibility matrix ingestion job accepted stringy bools and stale context size values from vendor metadata; ingestion lacked strict schema validation. Smart-routing relies on this matrix and attempted fallbacks to quantized variants incorrectly. Combined with cross-region fallback logic, this produced repeat failover oscillation and customer-impacting toolcall failures.

beth: action items (owners):
- kevin: SR rollback rule change is live (done), add automated canary check for oscillation patterns (in progress) [owner: kevin]
- alan: hotfix matrix ingestion to coerce/validate booleans and context ranges + add unit tests + integration test against runtime health [owner: alan]
- maria: run a sweep to reconcile runtime metadata vs matrix for all deployed variants and produce mismatch report [owner: maria]
- sara: coordinate post-incident customer comms and severity assessment; confirm SLA impact and bridge with CS [owner: sara]

sara: tagging this incident P1 -> start postmortem once stabilized. I'll keep the thread open for updates. Handoff to @beth at 2080123699.

beth: I have the handoff. Will follow up on follow-ups, schedule a joint session with ML infra and routing team. Please add any missing notes here.

alan: quick note for postmortem: add a regression test that simulates a variant with quantization + no tool_calling and ensure routing won't fallback across regions for streaming requests.

maria: export of mismatch report scheduled. Will attach to postmortem.

customer-success-bot: Customers notified that issue is mitigated; follow-up comms planned after postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident PD-9421 marked mitigated at 2080123525; awaiting postmortem.

beth: closing active paging. Leaving thread open for postmortem coordination and RCA docs.
